command:
set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/dev/null; echo COOKIE_LATEST=$(npm view cookie version); echo KIT_DEPS; npm view @sveltejs/kit@2.70.3 dependencies --json; echo ADAPTER_PEERS; npm view @sveltejs/adapter-static@3.0.10 peerDependencies dependencies --json; echo COOKIE_EXPLAIN; npm explain cookie; echo AUDIT; npm audit --json >/tmp/cookie-audit.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/cookie-audit.json'))
for name in ('cookie','@sveltejs/kit','@sveltejs/adapter-static'):
 v=d.get('vulnerabilities',{}).get(name)
 print(name, json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True) if v else 'CLEAN')
PY
